channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: Bondi claims win in ICE mask ban fight — but court ruled on different California case
item.description: U.S. Atty. Gen. Pam Bondi posted on social media that the Trump administration received a favorable ruling from the 9th Circuit Court of Appeals, which is true — just not in the case she referenced.

item.title: UCLA's Mick Cronin apologizes for ejecting player, says he's still 'a good fit' as coach
item.description: The Bruins leader said he thought Steven Jamerson II tried to take out an opponent, but the coach said he had a poor view and apologized for ejecting the player.

item.title: Conan O'Brien breaks silence over killing of Rob and Michele Reiner after his holiday party
item.description: Conan O'Brien breaks his silence on the death of his friends Rob and Michele Reiner, who were stabbed to death hours after attending a holiday party at the comedian's house.

item.title: Supreme Court ruling against Trump's tariffs leaves Mexico in cautious wait-and-see mode
item.description: Mexico has fought to escape tariffs from President Trump, but on Friday, the day the Supreme Court declared the import taxes illegal, Mexico's economy secretary urged "prudence" as officials sort out the impact of the ruling.

item.title: Citing racist past, this top California eatery added 20% surcharge. Then the backlash began
item.description: Burdell, an upscale restaurant serving nostalgic soul food, is the latest to be caught in contentious online debates about the U.S. tip culture.

item.title: Mothers, adventurers, sisters: The victims of Tahoe avalanche disaster
item.description: The women who were caught in the deadly avalanche Tuesday north of Lake Tahoe were a close group of friends, all mothers, who loved to spend time in the mountains.

item.title: Confidential memo reveals how LAFD tried shielding Mayor Bass from fire fallout
item.description: The LAFD issued a confidential memo detailing plans to protect Mayor Karen Bass and others from 'reputational harm' in connection with the city’s handling of the Palisades fire, records show.

item.title: What the Supreme Court's decision to strike down tariffs means for L.A.'s trade-dependent economy
item.description: The Supreme Court's decision Friday to strike down the majority of tariffs imposed by President Trump could provide some relief to L.A.'s trade-reliant economy — but only if they are not reimposed again through other means.

item.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump tariffs, stressing powers of Congress
item.description: The court said the president wrongly claimed support for his tariffs under a 1977 emergency powers law. Trump vowed to press ahead and impose tariffs under other laws.

item.title: Trump calls justices ‘fools,’ announces new 10% global tariff after Supreme Court setback
item.description: Trump told reporters that his administration will impose new tariffs by using alternative legal means.
